identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a 'Terminal Pro' aesthetic that feels like a high-end IDE mixed with Swiss design. Reject generic SaaS blues and gradients.
principles: Contrast: High contrast text, subtle borders, no muddy greys

fonts.usage: Code snippets, Tags, Technical specs, Accents

rules: Headings must be tight: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase + wide spacing: tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-xs

colors.strategy: Dark Mode Default. Use 'Zinc' scale for neutrals. Primary is Electric Indigo (Focus), Accent is Neon Green (Success/Code). Avoid gradients on backgrounds; use them only for text or subtle borders.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders with low opacity (border-white/10) instead of shadows for depth.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 for sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture to the background to kill the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use 'Tracing Beam' effects on active cards or hover states.
visual_enhancers.ascii: Use subtle ASCII art for 404 pages or loaders.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or small radius (rounded-md). No pill shapes for main actions.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px border, no shadow by default. Hover: border-primary/50.
components.inputs: Deep background (bg-zinc-900), border-zinc-800. Focus: border-primary ring-1 ring-primary.
components.charts: Use Recharts/Shadcn Charts. Colors: Indigo, Emerald, Amber, Rose, Cyan.

hero_bg.alt: Developer coding at night with laptop

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts, no 'Inter' everywhere.
Dark Mode First: Design for the developer eye (low strain, high contrast).
Micro-interactions: Every button click, hover, and focus must have a state change.
Spacing: Use p-8 or p-12 where others use p-4.
Data-TestID: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install fonts in index.css. 2. Update tailwind.config.js with the color palette. 3. Create a 'Layout' component that handles the sticky header and footer. 4. Use the provided image URLs for the Landing Page. 5. Build the Dashboard using the 'Control Room' grid strategy.
